checks.name: Bernstein–Sato coefficient identities
checks.detail: Exact rational coefficient equality for x^m, m=1,…,8, and x²y³; the quadratic Laplacian coefficient is 4(s+1)². Minimality is proved in the entry by normal-order exponent comparison.

checks.name: Conic polarity and tangent-locus test
checks.detail: Qp=(2,0,−1); Q⁻¹(Qp)=p. A rational point satisfies its tangent equation. The polar of the exterior point has dual quadratic value 3 and is not itself tangent.

checks.name: Ordered cross-ratio under a projectivity
checks.detail: The homogeneous tuple (−1,1;0,∞) has cross-ratio −1 before and after the determinant-one map z↦(2z+3)/(z+2).

checks.name: Heisenberg mode algebra on polynomial states
checks.detail: All 162 mixed-mode commutators tested equal mδ_mn on the selected monomials. L₂L₋₂ applied to the vacuum is exactly 1/2, giving c=1 in the stated Virasoro convention. These finite checks accompany, not replace, the formal proof.

checks.name: Four-site XXX spectrum and Bethe roots
checks.detail: The integer one-magnon Hamiltonian has a checked eigenbasis with energies 0,2,2,4. The three finite rapidities satisfy the one-root periodic Bethe equation and match the nonuniform-state energies; the uniform state is the infinite-root limit.

checks.name: Gaudin matrices and exact oper residual polynomials
checks.detail: The singlet and triplet Ω eigenvalues are verified with rational matrices. The polynomial 4g²(1+D′)−3D² is identically zero, proving V=3/(4g²), not merely sampling it. Both scaled solution residual polynomials vanish identically, and their Wronskian is exactly one. Full coefficient certificate is included.

checks.name: Complete rational three-site Gaudin spectrum and opers
checks.detail: For z=(0,1,8/3), roots 2 and4/9 produce two joint doublets; the vacuum family supplies a quartet. Eight explicit rational eigenvectors have rank8 and all three full Hamiltonians commute. Both Miura potential identities have exactly zero cross-multiplied residual polynomials, proving apparent-pole cancellation and residue/eigenvalue agreement.

checks.name: Independence arithmetic and dependence bounds
checks.detail: The exact rational product is approximately 0.00482230805327. Fréchet bounds from the 104 marginals are [0,0.95]. Enumerating the four XOR outcomes verifies pairwise independence while the three-way all-one event has probability zero.

checks.name: Nonlinear observation collision
checks.detail: For both initial states ±1, y(t)=1/(1+2t) satisfies y′=−2y² exactly at rational test times; the entry proves the full formula and convergence, so the sign collision holds for the entire time history.

checks.name: Klein–Gordon dispersion residual
checks.detail: For c=ℏ=1,m=2,k=(3,0,0),ω²=13 gives the exact polynomial residual −13+9+4=0. The general dispersion is derived directly in the entry.

checks.name: Pauli algebra and nonrelativistic energy expansion
checks.detail: Exact small-matrix products verify σ₁σ₂=iσ₃ and σᵢ²=I. The squared truncated polynomial (1+x/2−x²/8)² agrees with 1+x through x². The entry derives the magnetic sign from the covariant-momentum commutator.

checks.name: Exterior derivative and plane-wave checks
checks.detail: The mixed second-derivative coefficients cancel in d²χ and dF for the stated potential, while the vacuum dispersion residual ω²−k² vanishes. The proof uses d²=0 and states the local/global potential distinction.

checks.name: Ward difference identity and transverse null direction
checks.detail: The longitudinal vertex obeys the matrix-valued difference identity exactly for rational momenta in a two-dimensional Euclidean Clifford example. A separately constructed nonzero transverse term contracts to zero.

checks.name: Gaussian quartic perturbation coefficients
checks.detail: Gaussian-moment recurrence gives Z=1−g/8+35g²/384+… and normalized G₂=1−g/2+2g²/3+…. Connected logZ has second coefficient 1/12. The coefficient ratio grows asymptotically as 2n/3; the entry provides a finite-order remainder bound rather than claiming convergence.

checks.name: Toy beta flow and fixed-point slopes
checks.detail: g(t)=1/(1+e^t) satisfies β=−g+g² to numerical roundoff at sample times; β′(0)=−1 and β′(1)=1 are exact. The entry proves the formula and coordinate-invariance of fixed-point linearization.

checks.name: Regular-level velocity and critical-level failure
checks.detail: For radii 1,2,3 at t=1,4,9, the exact differentiated constraint 2rr′−1=0 holds. At t=0 the spatial gradient is zero, exactly violating the regular-level assumption; the entry proves the general normal-velocity formula.

scope: Exact coefficient and matrix checks where stated; isolated floating checks accompany proofs and do not replace them.
